name: trading-diary-exchange-proxy
description: Always-on Node service that talks to crypto exchange APIs on behalf of The Trading Diary. Exists because Supabase Edge Functions (Deno, serverless) have a documented, unresolved intermittent outbound-fetch/DNS failure (see https://github.com/supabase/edge-runtime/issues/263) that made exchange syncs unreliable. This service runs as a normal long-lived Node process (no cold starts), so it doesn't have that failure mode.
